name: lean-flow
description: Lean agentic development workflow with planning, gated execution, testing, debugging, documentation, and release skills.
skillInstructions: These skills are cross-platform (written tool-agnostically, first shipped for Claude Code). When a skill body references `${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}`, resolve it to the directory containing that skill's SKILL.md and read its `references/` and `templates/` files from there. Mentions of Claude-specific built-ins (`/code-review`, `/verify`, `/security-review`, the `Explore` agent) have no direct Kimi equivalent — use the closest available capability (e.g. the `explore` subagent) or do the step directly.

interface.shortDescription: A lean, gated agentic development workflow.
interface.longDescription: Plan, implement, test, diagnose, document, and release software through a curated set of composable development skills.
